_comment: Checks in common/dev/verify.mjs that are known to fail, each with why. A failure NOT listed here fails CI; a listed check that starts passing also fails CI, so this list has to shrink as things are fixed. Regenerate with: node common/dev/verify.mjs --update-baseline

known.downloading a session writes every file: The SD-transfer block breaks when a link CRC is on, and only then: with VERIFY_CRC=0 every one of these passes. Not diagnosed past that. The failure shape moves between runs (a 0xc1 list-response timeout, a part-written file, a transfer that reports Failed), so the whole block is listed rather than picked over. The two sibling defects in the same interaction ARE fixed and their checks now pass, which is the evidence that this one is real and not an environment quirk: the factory-test capture used to transcribe the ACK's CRC trailer as report text, and the Shimmer3R framer could not size the ExG register reply. Tracked in Jira as the SD-over-CRC ticket linked from DEV-976.
